articles.title: Supreme Court Hears Big Climate Change Case From Boulder, Colorado
articles.summary: The Supreme Court heard a case about whether Boulder, Colorado, can make two energy companies pay for climate-related disaster costs.

articles.title: Is It a Person or a Computer? Experts Share Tips on Young Kids and AI
articles.summary: Experts say parents can help young children learn that AI assistants like Alexa and Siri are computers, not people.

articles.title: Quebec Elects a Party That Wants Independence From Canada
articles.summary: Quebec's Parti Québécois, which wants independence from Canada, is projected to lead a minority government after Monday's election.
